overloads.semanticRole: The JSON Stringify array command converts the 4D array array into a serialized JSON array.

constraints: array may be of the text, real, Boolean, pointer, or object type.
If a scalar variable or field is passed instead of an array, the command still returns a valid JSON array string wrapping that single value in "[ ]".
The optional * parameter enables pretty formatting, improving readability when the result is displayed (e.g. in a Web page).
